decisions.title: Desktop exploration uses live discovered navigation
decisions.body: User steers validation toward desktop/web. Escape remains a live ship readout; dedicated ship/map/settings icons expose their own views. The map includes only canonically discovered sanctuaries with generated seeded coordinates and current position, not unseen-site guesses or invented biome borders. Held-left uses full forward thrust and right-fire controls facing. Gameplay owns articulation and immutable home/remote asteroid reward origins; production owns responsive navigation markup; engine owns pixel map primitives/PWA coherence; producer owns shell/input/API, tests and exact publication. Mobile UI remains functional but physical-device acceptance remains pending.

decisions.title: Minimal native HUD and real adaptive audio
decisions.body: Producer, Engine, Gameplay and Production agreed in actual asynchronous messages: use a docked flat bottom strip rather than scattered floating panels, attach constant-logical-size hull/shield bars through the actual unshaken interpolated camera, preserve real top-right icon hitboxes, and derive score changes from authoritative AudioHud pursuit/biome/champion/thrust/hull state. decisions.title: Keep presentation anchored to actual runtime and semantic geometry
decisions.body: Gameplay identified settings controls painted from the entire row; Root and Gameplay agreed on optional label_rect/control_rect measured in group-local logical units, preserving real input IDs and disabled state. Engine and Root agreed on a north-up player-centered minimap with fixed 2400-unit world range, yellow Haven and purple the authoritative tracked mission, reserving its exact exported bounds in facility and boss layout. Art identified front-facing tower art, anisotropic pads and vertical offsets; overhead coherent roof/courtyard bodies replace them while preserving facility centers and hit radius. Root keeps facility labels hidden except cursor hover or deliberate keyboard focus. These are implementation contracts; both-renderer browser acceptance and source reviews are still pending for these new refinements.
